Actions: add_keywords(ad_group_id, keywords[{text,match_type}], cpc_bid_micros?), pause_keyword(ad_group_id, criterion_id), enable_keyword(ad_group_id, criterion_id), remove_keyword(ad_group_id, criterion_id), update_bid(ad_group_id, criterion_id, cpc_bid_micros).
name: ads_keyword_admin
